verdict.rationale: Bento documents rules and alerts written in plain English that compile to trace queries, fire in real time on matching events, and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook. It also describes "trigger-based fixes" (skills, subagents, tools) that deploy automatically in shadow mode, and rules that live in the repo as Markdown/YAML, with signals editable via the CLI. Missing for 10: detailed docs on rule syntax and trigger conditions, actions beyond alert routing (trigger-based fixes are only thinly described), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
